name: Blessed Sight
description: Roll a die for each visible enemy fighter within (X)” of this fighter. For each result of 4+, add 1 wyrd dice to your saved wyrd dice.

name: Stealthy
description:
Whenever an enemy fighter is targeting this fighter, this fighter is in cover if both of the following are true:
- It is more than 6” from the enemy fighter.
- It is within 1” of an obstacle, or part of its base is underneath any part of a terrain piece.

name: One With The Shadows
description: A fighter cannot use this ability when visible to enemy fighters or when carrying treasure tokens. Remove this fighter from the battlefield. This fighter is now **hidden**.

name: Murder-Stab
description: Add (X/2) to the damage points allocated to enemy fighters by each hit and critical hit from the next melee attack action made by this fighter in this activation.

name: Skitterleap
description: *Magical ability*. A fighter cannot use this ability while within 1” of an enemy fighter or when carrying a treasure token. Remove this fighter from the battlefield, then set it up on the battlefield floor or on a platform, more than 6” from all enemy warriors, objective markers and treasure tokens.

name: Gnawdoom
description: *Magical ability*. Select an enemy fighter within 6” and roll (X) d6. For each roll that exceeds the target’s Defense characteristic, allocate 2 damage points to that enemy fighter.

name: Enshrouding Darkness
description: *Magical ability*. Until the end of the battleround, fighters within (X/2)" of this fighter are not visible to fighters more than 1" away from them.

name: Pack Tactics
description: Select a visible friendly `Henchman` within 3" of this fighter. That fighter makes a free move action or a free attack action.

name: Sigmar’s Blessing
description:
This fighter may call for one of Sigmar’s Blessings by spending saved Wyrd Dice:

- **Heart of Steel:** During this fighter’s activation, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to automatically pass a panic test.
- **Righteous Fury:** During this fighter’s activation, after making a hit roll, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to turn a hit into a critical hit.
- **Sigmar Protects:** During an enemy fighter’s activation, you may discard one saved Wyrd Dice to perform a reaction with this fighter without needing or spending an action to do so.

name: Fearsome
description: Enemy fighters must take a Panic test when making melee attack actions against this fighter.

name: Oppressor
description: Once per battle round, when an enemy fighter makes the ‘Retreat’ action, this fighter can make the ‘Cut Them Down’ reaction without having to forfeit an action to do so.

name: Weapon Master
description: Select a melee weapon type. When making attack actions with weapons of that type, increase the critical damage characteristic by 1.

name: Staggering Blows
description: For this fighter's activation, when making Melee Attack actions, enemy fighters cannot make reactions.

name: Shield Bash
description: This ability requires the fighter being equipped with a shield. Select an enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter. That fighter makes a free retreat action directly away from this fighter. If it cannot move away from this fighter, allocate (X/2) damage points to that fighter instead.

name: Press the Advantage
description: A fighter can only use this ability if an enemy fighter has been taken down by an attack action made by them this activation. This fighter makes a bonus move action or a bonus attack action.

name: Indomitable
description: Each time this fighter is activated, you can remove D3 damage points allocated to them.

name: Nine Lives
description: When rolling for injuries, this fighter can re-roll a result of 11-12. In addition, there is no limit to the amount of permanent injuries this fighter may have.

name: Tough
description: Each time an attack action scores any critical hits on this fighter, 1 of those critical hits becomes a hit instead.

name: Endure
description: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by an attack action but before the hit rolls are made. Subtract 1 from the damage points allocated by each hit and critical hit (to a minimum of 1) from that attack action.

name: Shield Wall
description: Until the end of the battle round, add (X/2) to the Defense characteristic of all friendly fighters within 1" of this fighter when targeted by ranged attack actions.

name: Duelist
description: Once per battle round, this fighter can make the ‘Counter’ reaction without having to forfeit an action to do so.

name: Infiltrator
description: At the beginning of the first battle round, this fighter can make a free move action.

name: Wall-Runner
description: This fighter may ignore the first 3" moved vertically when climbing or falling.

name: Step-Aside
description: A fighter can make this reaction after they are targeted by a melee attack action but before any hit rolls are made. Roll 1 dice for each successful hit. On a 4+, that hit counts as a miss and is discarded.

name: Disengage
description:
A fighter can only use this ability if they are
within 1" of an enemy fighter. This fighter makes a free Retreat action.

name: Trip
description: After this fighter’s next melee attack action in this activation, if at least 1 hit roll from that attack action results in a hit, the target must forfeit 1 of their actions in this battle round. If the target has already activated or if they have no more actions to forfeit, allocate (X/2) damage points to the target instead.

name: Quick Shot
description: This fighter makes a free ranged attack action.

name: Eagle Eyes
description: When making an attack action using a bow, crossbow or handgun, this fighter may ignore the maximum range of the weapon, but if they do, they must reduce their Shoot characteristic by 1.

name: Rapid Reload
description: At the end of the battleround, you may reload one of this fighter’s weapons with the Reload special rule.

name: Surgical Precision
description: Select a ranged weapon type. When making attack actions with weapons of that type, increase the Critical Damage characteristic by 1.

name: Trick Shot
description: When this fighter makes a ranged attack action, the target does not count as being in cover.

name: Patient Hunter
description: When an enemy fighter ends a move action while visible to this fighter, this fighter can target that enemy fighter with a free ranged attack action.

name: Reckless Shot
description: For this fighter’s next ranged attack action, it may target enemy fighters within 1" of friendly fighters.

name: Arcane Attunement
description: `Wizard` only. Start each battle with one additional Wyrd Dice.

name: Tactician
description: `LEADER` only. Start each battle with one additional Wyrd Dice.

name: Pious
description: `Priest` only.Start each battle with one additional Wyrd Dice.

name: Charismatic
description: Once per battle, this fighter can use the ‘Inspiring Presence’ ability without needing or spending ability dice to do so.

name: Underground Contacts
description: When employing a `hired sword`, roll a d6. On a 4+, you may reduce the hiring fee by 50% (rounding up).

name: Maintain Momentum
description: `Leader` only. When seizing the initiative, if there is a tie, do not roll off. Instead the player controlling this fighter chooses which tied player has the initiative. If multiple warbands have this talent, the players of those warbands roll off, and the winner chooses which tied player has the initiative.

name: Cut and run
description: A fighter can make this reaction after they have been allocated the total damage points by a melee attack action. This fighter makes a free Retreat action.

name: Lead the Charge
description: A fighter can use this ability after ending a move action within 1" of an enemy fighter. Up to (X/2) friendly fighters within 6" of this fighter can make a bonus move action, but must end that move action closer to this fighter.

name: Warcry
description: Friendly fighters within 6" of this fighter are no longer panicked, and do not have to take Bravery tests until the end of the battleround.

name: Strategize
description: During this activation, when this fighter makes a wait action, roll (X) dice. For each roll of 4+, you may add 1 wyrd dice do your saved wyrd dice.

name: Driven by Greed
description: A fighter can only use this ability if it is carrying, or is within 1” of a treasure token. Add 1 to the Fight and Attacks characteristic of this fighter’s next melee attack action.

name: Hunter’s Eye
description: For this fighter’s next ranged attack action, add 1 to the damage points allocated to the target by each hit and critical hit.

name: Martial Discipline
description: When this fighter is recruited to the warband you may increase it’s Fight or Shoot characteristic by 1.

name: Lead By Example
description: A fighter can use this ability after taking an enemy fighter out of action. Select up to two visible friendly fighters with the `HENCHMAN` keyword within 6” of this fighter. Each of those fighters can make a free move or a free attack action.

name: Command
description:
Place a **command token** within 12" of this fighter and select one of the effects below:
- **Seize**: Until the end of the battleround, friendly fighters may increase their Fight or Shoot characteristic by 1 when attacking a target within 3" of the token.
- **Hold**: Until the end of the battleround, friendly fighters within 3" of that token may increase their Defense and Bravery characteristics by 1.

name: Condemn
description: Select up to (X/2) visible enemy fighters without an Accused token and assign each one an Accused token. Increase Zeal by 1 for each token assigned this way, or by 3 if that fighter has the `WIZARD`, `DAEMON`, or `VAMPIRE` keyword.

name: Incite Rabble
description: Select a friendly `Henchman` within 6”. That `Henchman` makes a free move action. Increase Zeal by 1.

name: Self-Flagellation
description: Allocate (X/2) damage points to this fighter and increase Zeal by 1. Then, this fighter makes a free attack action.

name: Death Grip
description: After this fighter's next melee attack action in this activation, if at least 1 hit roll from that attack action results in a hit, the target forfeits 1 of their actions in this battle round. If the target has already activated or if they have no more actions to forfeit, allocate 3 damage points to the target instead.

name: Unshakeable
description: This fighter automatically passes any Panic tests it is required to take.

name: Penitent
description: This fighter cannot be equipped with ranged weapons or wear any armour.

name: Words of Healing
description: Remove (X/2) damage points allocated to each friendly fighter within 6" of this fighter. If you discard a saved wyrd dice, remove (X) damage points instead.

name: Hammer of Sigmar
description: A fighter can only use this ability if equipped with a Warhammer or Sigmarite Hammer. Add (X/2) to the damage points allocated to enemy fighters by each hit and critical hit from the next melee attack action made by this fighter in this activation.

name: Soulfire
description: Allocate (X/2) damage points to each visible enemy fighter within 6” of this fighter. If the enemy fighter is a `Vampire`, `Daemon` or `Thrall`, allocate (X) damage points instead.

name: Touch of chaos
description: *Magical ability*. Select a visible fighter within 1” of this fighter. That fighter must take a Bravery test. If the test fails, the fighter is immediately removed from the battlefield. The fighter does not count as taken out of action, but gains the `MUTANT` keyword.

name: Puppet Master
description: *Magical ability*. Select a visible fighter within 6" of this fighter. That fighter must pass a Bravery test or immediately make a free Move, Retreat, or Attack action of your choice (a friendly fighter can choose to automatically fail the Bravery test).

name: Curse of Agony
description: *Magical ability*. Select a visible fighter within 12" of this fighter and roll (X) dice. For each result of 2+, allocate 1 damage point to that fighter.

name: Armour of Faith
description: This fighter refuses to wear any armour, and is always considered to be in Cover.

name: Ascended
description: When this fighter is recruited to the warband, it must make a roll on the mutation table. It refuses to be equipped with any equipment, weapons or armour.

name: Hollowed
description: This fighter automatically passes any Bravery tests it is required to take.

name: Anointed
description: When this fighter is recruited to the warband, it must make a roll on the mutation table.

name: The Beast Within
description:
When a Vampire is deployed to the battlefield, roll a die: On a 1-5, the vampire is **ravenous**, on a 6 - the Vampire is **empowered**.

Once per battle round, when a **ravenous** vampire is activated, it can perform a free move action. However, while ravenous, a vampire cannot use reactions or abilities, except Feed (see below).

An **empowered vampire** can use multiple abilities in each activation. The same ability can be used more than once, but abilities that grant free actions must be fully resolved before another ability can be used. In addition, once per battle round when an empowered vampire uses an ability, you can either add a double with a value of 3, treat a double as a triple, or a triple as a quad. After the ability is resolved, this fighter’s activation ends and it becomes ravenous.

name: Feed
description: Allocate X/2 damage points to a visible fighter within 1” of this fighter. Then, remove X/2 damage points from this fighter. If this fighter is ravenous, it becomes empowered instead.

name: For the Master
description: A fighter can make this reaction when a `VAMPIRE` within 3" of them is targeted by an attack action, after the damage is totalled but before it is allocated, if it is enough for that `VAMPIRE` to be taken out of action. Allocate those damage points, one at a time, to this fighter instead. If this fighter is taken out of action, allocate any remaining damage points to that friendly `VAMPIRE`.

name: Shambling Horde
description: Select up to 3 visible friendly fighters with the `Zombie` keyword. Those fighters can each immediately make a bonus move action of up to 3", as long as they end that move action closer to this fighter.

name: Chilling Howl
description: Until the end of the battle round, enemy fighters within 6" of this fighter must pass a Bravery Test to make reactions or use abilities.

name: Whack
description: Select an enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter. That fighter makes a free move action directly away from this fighter, as if it jumped. When making that move action, it can move up to (X"). If it cannot move away from this fighter, allocate (X/2) damage points to that fighter instead.

name: Bodyguard
description: A fighter can make this reaction when a friendly `HERO` within 1" is targeted by an attack action. That attack action targets this fighter instead.

name: Deathwish
description: When this warrior is targeted by a melee attack action that inflicts enough damage to take this warrior out of action, before it is removed from the battlefield, this warrior makes a free attack action.

name: Frenzy
description: A fighter can only use this ability if it has been allocated 8 or more damage points. This fighter makes a free melee attack action.

name: Guard
description: When this fighter makes the Wait action, increase it's Defense characteristic by 2 until its next activation.

name: Heckle
description: Select (X/2) enemy fighters that is within 6" of this fighter. Until the end of the battle round, when making attack actions, those fighters must reduce their Fight and Shoot characteristics by 3, unless those attack actions target this fighter.

name: Snatch
description: A fighter can use this ability while within 1" of an enemy fighter carrying a treasure or wyrdstone token. Roll a d6: on a 2+, this fighter steals the token. Then, this fighter makes a free Retreat action.

name: Wither
description:
Select a visible enemy fighter within 12”. That fighter must reduce its Move, Fight and Shoot characteristic by (X/2) until the end of the battle
round.

name: Flight of Zimmerman
description:
*Magical Ability.* This fighter makes a free move action, and for that move action, they count as flying. However, while flying, they cannot move vertically upwards more
than (X)".

name: Fires of U'Zhul
description: Select an enemy fighter within 12" of this fighter to be the target and roll three d6. For each roll of 3+, allocate (X/2) damage to the target. For each roll of 6, allocate (X/2) damage points to all visible fighters within 2" of the target.

name: Stupidity
description: Unless activated within 3" of a visible friendly `HERO` or enemy fighter, roll a die. On a 1-4, this fighter makes a Wait action. On a 5+, this fighter may activate as normal.

name: Bounding Leaps
description: A fighter can only use this ability if there is a visible enemy fighter within 6" of them. This fighter makes a bonus move action and must finish closer to the closest visible enemy fighter than they were at the start of that move action.

name: Savage Mauling
description: This fighter makes a free melee attack action. Then, you may remove the target of that attack action from the battlefield, and place it back anywhere within 1" of this fighter.

name: Bestial Rage
description: Whenever this fighter has any damage points allocated to it, you must increase its Attacks characteristic by 1, and reduce its Defense characteristic by 1.

name: Headlong Charge
description: A fighter can only use this ability if there is an enemy fighter within 6” of it. This fighter makes a free Move action, and must end that move action within 1” of that enemy fighter. Then, inflict (X/2) damage points to that enemy fighter.

name: Denounce
description: A fighter may use this reaction when a visible fighter within 6” is the target of a magical ability. Roll a d6: if the result is higher than this fighter’s Bravery characteristic, the ability is cancelled and the ability dice discarded.

name: Voice of Sigmar
description: Increase the Bravery characteristic of all visible friendly fighters within 3” of this fighter by 1. In addition, if this fighter is recruited by a `Witch Hunter` warband, you may increase the warband's Zeal by 1 whenever this fighter uses an ability.

name: Raise Dead
description: Set up a new Zombie wholly within 3" of this fighter, on a platform or the battlefield floor. That Zombie is considered to be a friendly fighter, and can be activated as normal in this battleround. It has (X) damage points remaining. Raised Zombies are not added to the warband roster and crumble to dust at the end of the battle.

name: Transference
description: Allocate up to (X) damage points to a fighter within 12” of this fighter, and then remove the same amount of damage points from a friendly fighter within 3” of this fighter.

name: Vanhel’s Danse Macabre
description: Until the end of the battle round, `THRALLS` activated within (X)” of this fighter may increase their Move characteristic by 2, and their Attacks characteristics by 1.

name: Sudden Accusation
description: Make this reaction when a visible friendly fighter is taken out of action by a visible enemy fighter. That enemy fighter gains an accused token. Increase Zeal by 1.

name: Distracting Shot
description: For this fighter’s next ranged attack action, it may target an enemy fighter within 1” of friendly fighters. If the attack hits, one of those friendly fighters can make a free Retreat action.

name: Display of Brutality
description: A fighter can use this ability only if an enemy fighter has been taken down by an attack action made by them this activation. Until the end of the battle round, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee attack action made by friendly fighters while they are within 6" of this fighter.
